title: CRM sync
gate: Needs the vendor app credentials in the deployment before it can go live

options.pushNew: Create records at the vendor for CRM records that have no match
options.pushNewHelp: Off by default. Edits to records that are already linked always sync; this only decides whether brand-new CRM records are sent out.
options.importMode: When an imported record matches one already in the CRM
options.importModeSkip: Keep the CRM's record and link them
options.importModeMerge: Write the vendor's non-empty values over the CRM's record

region.label: Zoho data centre
region.help: Choose the data centre your Zoho account lives in. India (.in) is the default.

conflict.title: When both sides changed the same field
conflict.help: Only a field changed on both sides since the last sync is a conflict. Any other change simply travels to the other side.

setup.invalid_region: Choose one of the listed data centres.
setup.token_rejected: The vendor rejected the saved authorisation. Reconnect and try again.
setup.not_configured: The vendor app credentials are missing in this deployment.
setup.vault_failed: The settings could not be stored safely. Nothing was changed.
setup.audit_failed: The change could not be recorded in the audit log, so it was not made.

reasons.import_contact_required: No email or phone to reach the person
reasons.duplicate_in_file: Same person as another record in this import
reasons.duplicate_of_linked: Same person as a record that is already linked
reasons.stage_unmapped: The deal's stage has no mapping. Map it in the field map and sync again
reasons.lookup_pending: A linked record has not been imported yet; it is picked up on a later pass
reasons.link_table_mismatch: This record was imported into a different object earlier
reasons.remote_missing: The record was deleted at the vendor
reasons.remote_deleted: Deleted at the vendor. The CRM record was kept
reasons.transform_failed: A value could not be converted
reasons.channel_mismatch: A notification meant for another connection was ignored
reasons.portal_mismatch: A notification from a different HubSpot account was ignored
reasons.portal_unbound: Finish the HubSpot setup to receive notifications
reasons.watch_failed: Zoho notifications could not be registered; syncing continues on the schedule
